data.exact_reserve_text: In 2023, there has been an overall net surplus in ultimate claims of GBP 23.0m (2022: GBP 7.0m deficit) due to higher than expected incurred movements across most classes of business.

prior_year_events.impact_description: The syndicate continues to have material exposure to Hurricane Ida; current ultimate estimated losses were reported (USD figures) and remain covered by reinsurance.
The syndicate has material exposure to Hurricane Ian; projected ultimate gross losses were reported in USD and the net impact after reinsurance was forecast (USD).
2020 wind events experienced deterioration in the year with the gross ultimate moving out in aggregate (USD figures), partially mitigated by reinsurance recoveries.
The syndicate's gross ultimate provision for Covid-19 across all years was reported and has reduced year on year; litigation has developed favourably but uncertainty remains.

named_events.loss_description: Current ultimate estimated losses for Hurricane Ida are gross $146.7m (2022: $145.8m) and net $47.5m (2022: $48.3m); covered by surplus and excess of loss reinsurance.
Projected ultimate gross losses (USD) with a forecast net impact after reinsurance; syndicate has material exposure.
2020 wind events experienced deterioration in the year with the gross ultimate moving out from $102.7m to $111.0m in aggregate.
Gross ultimate provision for Covid-19 across all years reported at $19.6m (last year $24.5m); most litigation has developed favourably though uncertainty remains.

data.standardized_narrative: Using the detailed gross claims development triangle, the syndicate experienced a gross prior-year release of c. GBP 28.2m (4.7% of opening gross claims reserves) in 2023. The release reflected favourable claims development across multiple classes (notably long-tail casualty and motor/auto), partially offset by deterioration in some prior catastrophe-exposed years (notably 2020 wind events). Named large losses (Hurricane Ian 2022, Hurricane Ida 2021, 2020 wind events) and the Covid-19 provision were highlighted in the report; the net reported surplus after reinsurance was GBP 23.0m.
raw_causal_phrases: due to higher than expected incurred movements across most classes of business.
A positive run-off of GBP 21.0m on the 2020 and prior years' reserves (2019 and prior: GBP 22.8m) was experienced in the year.
There was a gross back-year release of GBP 20.4m
The long-tail casualty classes generated a GBP 7.0m gross back-year release
The short-tail account generated a GBP 6.6m gross back-year release

The GBP 6.7m gross back-year release is largely driven by the auto account on the 2019 and 2020 years as the benign experience increasingly highlights the different development pattern for these years.
The syndicate continues to have material exposure to Hurricane Ida.
The current ultimate gross loss is $19.6m (2022: $24.5m) and net loss $19.0m (2022: $23.8m).

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: Prior-year development (gross) was calculated from the report's gross claims development triangle (claims outstanding triangle) because the report text primarily quoted net (after reinsurance) movements. The triangle includes reinsurance-to-close liabilities accepted from Syndicate 6103 for certain years (2007-2020) which are shown in the triangle as if always 2791 liabilities; this may distort comparisons for years affected by those RITC transfers. Some large event amounts in the narrative are reported in USD; where amounts are only given in USD they are not converted and event-specific GBP amounts are set to null.
